decision.recommendation: Adopt the bounded raw-versus-query-percentile C1 selector; preserve all existing main/neural artifacts and inference.
decision.reason: Initial 39-condition held-out mean gain +0.005710 with positive family means; disjoint MSLR confirmation gain +0.009717. A fixed query-percentile model has slightly higher initial mean (+0.006107) but worse initial worst regression. Raw/rank selection retains a known baseline fallback and conservative inner tie preference. Weak/noisy generated labels regress by 0.008150 on average, so improvement is not universal.
decision.final_verification: 126 real-artifact tests pass (one toy-model-only test deselected); all 127 isolated-toy tests pass. All nine production model-byte agreement cases pass; 500k x 300 sparse/dense adaptive stress passes (400.50/669.81 seconds, less than 3.0 GiB peak). Full fresh staged main-model refit is byte-identical, with identical predictions and rankings.

protocol.adaptive_rule: 31 leaves for >=400 gradient queries; baseline otherwise
protocol.note: Outer folds are never inputs to stopping or candidate selection; correlated conditions are not independent replications.

confirmation/protocol.json.MSLR_queries: seed193 shuffled TRAIN IDs [2250:4050], disjoint from initial pools
confirmation/protocol.json.acceptance: Confirm positive equal-family raw/rank mean delta, no family mean below -.005; initial extension gate must also pass.
